risks.quote: Use of AI in research can have significant ethical implications.
If you outsource this to Generative AI, then you are not going to get that experience.

responsibilities.quote: There are many third party Generative AI tools available. As with all third party software, you should ensure that you are using it safely, responsibly, and ethically.
Your department might have its own local Generative AI guidance which you must follow.
All staff and students are automatically enrolled on this course. We recommend engaging with this course before using Generative AI.
